keyPoints: Bahupad (polynomial): charon ke ghaat wale padon ka jod — jaise 4x^3 + 2x - 7.
Ghaat (degree): sabse badi power — 4x^3 + 2x - 7 ki degree 3 hai.
Padon ki ginti se naam: ek-padi, dvi-padi, tri-padi.
Sheshfal pramey (remainder theorem): p(x) ko (x-a) se bhaag do to sheshfal p(a) milta hai.
Gunankhand pramey (factor theorem): agar p(a) = 0 ho to (x-a) uska gunankhand hai.
Madhya pad todo (split the middle term): x^2 + 5x + 6 = (x+2)(x+3).
